host_profile: opn1 / WYM1 / 4MHz reference only for first acceptance
startup_sequence: Keep YM reset asserted, module enable low, final DAC_XSMT gate closed
Wait for SYS_INIT clear with deadline; no config writes while busy
Disable all clock outputs (register3); power down unused CLK1/2
Set CL8pF register183 with reserved bits per AN619; configure PLL and MultiSynth for 25MHz reference
Read back masks, reset PLL, check stable status with bounded timeout
Enable CLK0 only; verify clock status before source reset release
Initialize source muted, prime ADC/I2S/DAC, require explicit HOST/MIDI start
fault_policy: clock I2C NACK/readback/PLL fault closes gates, asserts source reset, clears queued work; no automatic replay
clock_change_policy: STOP and mute first; change clock only while stopped; legacy HOST defaults remain 4MHz
